# xterm.js

The terminal in each shell pane. These are unmodified files from two npm packages.

| File | Package | Path in package |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `xterm.js` | [`@xterm/xterm` 6.0.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xterm/xterm/v/6.0.0) | `lib/xterm.js` |
| `xterm.css` | `@xterm/xterm` 6.0.0 | `css/xterm.css` |
| `xterm.LICENSE.txt` | `@xterm/xterm` 6.0.0 | `LICENSE` |
| `xterm-addon-fit.js` | [`@xterm/addon-fit` 0.11.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xterm/addon-fit/v/0.11.0) | `lib/addon-fit.js` |
| `xterm-addon-fit.LICENSE.txt` | `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.11.0 | `LICENSE` |

- Source: https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
- Licence: MIT, included in the two licence files.

The files load from this folder, so the interface needs no network and no build step. To update, replace them with the same paths from newer packages and change the versions above.
